done: Built signed.py, the Q-1s instrument, with report, --selftest and --json modes. It uses stdlib, numpy and sympy. measure.py (A3) and tools/cypher.py are imported, never copied or edited.

(1) Principal-branch complex entropy. Re H = -sum p ln|p| is the same on every branch; Im H = pi N. The branch set is tabulated over the grid k in [-2,2]^2. The multi-axis table covers per-entry ln|p|, principal and reflected arg, Re and Im contributions, the inverse axis -Log p, and the Im step per unit k. Also tabulated: the N-sweep (Re, Im, -Im, M) and the uniform-shift rule (-2 pi i k).

(2) Products. Re H is additive; Im H = pi(N_p P_q + P_p N_q), which exceeds Im H(p) + Im H(q) by exactly 2 pi N_p N_q; M is additive and is zero only when no entry is negative; N = (sum|p| - 1)/2. Checked numerically on 400 random pairs and exactly in sympy. Control: with sum p = 2 the Re H identity fails (residual 2.4250).

(3) Exact range of Re H for n entries and negativity N: min = -P ln P + N ln(N/(n-1)), max = -P ln(P/(n-1)) + N ln N, with P = 1 + N. Re H < 0 is forced only at n = 2. For n >= 3 the smallest value of max Re H over N is exactly ln(n-2), at N = 1/(n-2). A random search found no point outside the bounds.

(4) The Baez-Fritz-Leinster axioms (1106.1791v3 Thm 2) restated for signed measures. Functoriality holds for any difference of a state function, so that check is labelled STRUCTURAL. Re H fails the [0,inf) codomain (counterexample: merging two negative entries). M fails convex linearity (computed counterexample). Im H passes all four. A 12-functional dictionary was run through SVD null spaces. The Brandenburger-La Mura axioms (2410.15976v5) were also checked: their Example 1 reproduces; Re H fails their Axiom 5' (|w| weights) and satisfies it with signed weights; the signed-weight exponential branch fails their Axiom 0.

(5) Triangulation. Filtered back-projection (inverse Radon) recovers the negative region of the Wigner function of (|0>+|1>)/sqrt2 from its exact non-negative marginals. Controls: 2 angles fail; the vacuum reconstructs non-negative at 180 angles but not at 3; one finite-sample run (72 angles x 20000 shots, single seed) still shows the negativity. Exact discrete case: Born probabilities on the d+1 striations give qubit W(0,0) = 1/4 - sqrt3/4 and qutrit strange-state W(0,0) = -1/3 (GHW eq.55). Control: with only 3 of the qutrit's 4 striations, two valid states share every kept marginal but differ at the origin.

(6) Read at source via alphaXiv: 2310.19296v1, 2512.03505v1, 2410.15976v5, 2503.03759v1, 1307.7171v1, 1201.1256v4, quant-ph/0401155v6, quant-ph/0602001v3, quant-ph/0406015v1, quant-ph/0511044v2 and 1106.1791v3, each cited with pages. Named but not read: Smithey 1993 (whose content is read via the quant-ph/0511044 review, p.3), Wootters 1987, Renyi 1961 / Daroczy 1963, and Lvovsky 2001.

(7) Applications: (a) the qubit state with Bloch vector (-1,-1,-1)/sqrt3, whose negativity depends on which of the two quantum nets is used; (b) A3's Bell pair, imported; (c) a Mobius signed weighting of cypher's Lambda, reached through A3's route.

results: The branch shift on entry i adds -2 pi i k_i p_i to H, not 2 pi i k (discrepancy D1). The reflection (conjugate) is itself one of the branches. |e^H| = e^{Re H} on every branch, while the phase of e^H is preserved only by a uniform shift.

Prior art: the complex Wigner entropy is already defined in 2310.19296v1, including Im proportional to negative volume, Re additive and Im superadditive (Delta = (2/pi) h_i h_i). That paper treats continuous variables only.

Within the dictionary: the convex-linear lawful family is span{Re H, N}; the product-additive family is span{Re H, M, Hartley, signed Renyi-2}; requiring both leaves Re H alone. If BFL's [0,inf) codomain is kept as well, only b*pi*N survives, and it is zero on every probability measure. So no dictionary functional extends Shannon while meeting all four BFL hypotheses on signed measures.
(Re H, M) is not forced: M is not convex-linear. Derived: the continuous product-additive function of N alone is c*M.

Brandenburger-La Mura fork: with |w| weights in their mean-value axiom the result is signed Renyi; with signed weights it is Re H. The second is derived conditionally, on the unread Renyi-Daroczy step and not machine-checked. Uniqueness over all continuous functionals is OPEN.
Filtered back-projection at 180 angles: max error 1.0e-4, min -0.11338 against exact -0.11332, negative-region IoU 1.000. At 2 angles: IoU 0.037. Fock |1>: -0.31839 against -1/pi.
Continuous checks reproduce two published values: vacuum Re h_c = ln pi + 1 (2310.19296 eq.49) and Fock |1> Im h_c = 0.669353 (from Kenfack-Zyczkowski delta).
Qutrit strange state: N = 1/3, M = ln(5/3), Re H = (4/3)ln6 - (1/3)ln3 = 2.022809 nats.
Bell pair: N = 1/2, Re H = 3 bits, M = 1 bit. Re H(AB) - Re H(B) = +1 bit, against A3's von Neumann S(A|B) = -1 bit: Re H does not reproduce the quantum conditional entropy.

Lambda Mobius weighting: 159 entries at +1 and 158 at -1, so N = 158, Re H = 0 exactly (every |p| = 1) and M = 8.308 bits. Box-mixture weighting q: Re H = -3.033 bits, N = 81.70. The uniform measure on Lambda gives 9.930737 bits, matching A3.
open: Uniqueness of the lawful pair over all continuous functionals, with and without BFL's codomain.
Machine-checking the signed-weight Brandenburger-La Mura derivation; the Renyi 1961 / Daroczy 1963 step (H-RD) is named but not read.
Ruling for M: which weighting in the mean-value axiom is lawful for The Method, |w| or signed w. This decides between signed Renyi and Re H.
A fuller prior-art search on finite-set signed and complex entropy: only two discovery searches plus targeted reads were done.
What M means by 'inverses and reflections' (H-READING-M), to be asked of M.
The operational meaning of Re H once entries are negative (2310.19296v1 p.13 says it is missing in the continuous case too).

results: When no weight is negative, Shannon comes back exactly. On 301 vectors (random, some with exact zeros, plus uniform Lambda), Re H equals measure.H bit for bit, Im H is 0 and N is 0. The largest |M| is 1.1e-14 nats. signed_loss equals F_shannon bit for bit on 300 random FinProb morphisms.
At the boundary, a weight crossing zero from below joins the Shannon case. The Re H gap falls from 4.9e-2 to 2.3e-9 as e goes from 1e-2 to 1e-10, and Im H and M go to 0.

R-INDEX on Lambda through q1, reproducing Q1s-build's figures: uniform weighting is SHANNON at 9.930737 bits. The Mobius p weighting is SIGNED: 317 cells (159 at +1, 158 at -1), N = 158, Re H = 0, Im H = 158 pi, M = log2 317 = 8.3083 bits. The box-mixture q weighting is SIGNED: Re H = -3.033176 bits, N = 81.6988, M = 7.3610 bits. The full-box control is SHANNON on one point.

Theorem 2's codomain [0, inf) fails on signed morphisms. Crushing (1.5,-0.5) to a point loses -0.954771 nats. Merging (1.6,-0.3,-0.3) to (1.6,-0.6) loses -0.6 ln 2 = -0.415888 nats with N unchanged. So the BFL uniqueness result does not carry over to signed weights (H-FINSIGNED), and uniqueness over all continuous functionals is OPEN.

Finding: Re H has no ceiling of ln n. With n = 1 the only weighting is (1), so Re H = 0 = phi(1). With n = 2, Re H is negative at every N tested. With n = 3 the extremal vector gives 0.1699, 4.2736 and 64.3977 nats at N = 2, 10 and 100, against ln 3 = 1.0986, and Re H grows without bound in N. problems.site: Q1s-signed.md s.4 ('Inside this dictionary, no functional extends Shannon and keeps all four BFL hypotheses on signed measures'; 'What is shown about uniqueness' (a), (b), (e); OPEN 1); A3-measure.md s.(vii) ('Within a 12-functional dictionary the lawful family is span{Re H, N} ... Over all continuous functionals, uniqueness is OPEN') and the Q1S_GRADE_REVIEW H-INFO row ('clause (a) ... OPEN for signed ones')
problems.wrong: The lawful-family results are confined to the 12-functional dictionary (H-DICTIONARY). A short proof extends them to every continuous separable functional X(s) = sum_i g(s_i), but it was not done. That leaves uniqueness 'OPEN' where most of it can be shown.
problems.correct: DERIVED, with each step shown, and COMPUTED as a check. (i) Functoriality gives F(f) = X(p) - X(q) (BFL p.9 eq.8, re-READ; the step is structural and holds on FinSigned too). (ii) Convex linearity with lambda in [0,1] (BFL p.4 eq.2, re-READ), applied to !_p and !_q, gives X(lambda p + (1-lambda) q) = X(lambda, 1-lambda) + lambda X(p) + (1-lambda) X(q). (iii) For separable X, phi_lambda(x) = g(lambda x) - lambda g(x) then satisfies sum_i phi_lambda(s_i) = phi_lambda(1) for every signed s with total 1. Comparing (x, y, 1-x-y) with (x+y, 1-x-y) gives Cauchy's equation, so under continuity phi_lambda is linear (the general solution is READ as cited, 2410.15976v5 p.10, Lemma A.1). (iv) Hence g(lambda x) = lambda g(x) + A_lambda x. Shannon on FinProb fixes A_lambda = -c lambda ln lambda, and the scale invariance of g(x)/x + c ln|x| on each half-line gives g(x) = -c x ln|x| + beta x for x < 0. So X = c Re H + b N exactly. COMPUTED check: in a 14-function separable basis (x ln|x|, x, x^2, x^3, x ln^2|x|, |x|^1.5, |x|^2.5, on each sign), 400 random convex-linearity rows plus X(pt) = 0 leave a null space of dimension 2, equal to span{Re H, N} (residual 9e-14). Control: without the convex-linearity rows the null space has dimension 13. Consequences, over ALL continuous separable functionals (H-SEPARABLE replaces H-DICTIONARY): with BFL's codomain kept, only b N (b >= 0) survives, because the merge (1.6, -0.3, -0.3) -> (1.6, -0.6) has dRe H = -0.415888 and dN = 0. With the codomain dropped, the family is c Re H + b N. Adding product additivity gives c Re H alone, since N(pq) - N(p) - N(q) = 2 N_p N_q (0.2 at (1.5, -0.5) x (1.2, -0.2)). This is a uniqueness theorem for Re H that needs neither H-RD nor the Brandenburger-La Mura fork. For H-INFO clause (a) on signed weights it means: SUPPORTED-IF {H-SEPARABLE, BFL codomain dropped, product additivity}, and impossible if the codomain is kept. Uniqueness over NON-separable functionals stays OPEN, and genuinely so: a signed atom such as (1.5, -0.5) cannot be split by any lambda in [0,1], so convex linearity does not constrain X on atoms. Not machine-checked. Obstruction grades do not move; one clause status does.
